title: Initial and remaining coordinates partition a block
statement: For any block index $b$ and seed index $s$ in $\{0,1,2\}$, the union of the singleton containing coordinate $s$ in block $b$ and the other two coordinates of that block is exactly the set of all three coordinates in block $b$ in the nine-coordinate array.
